answer: To resist Sybil attacks in an agent economy, we deploy the **Trellis-Stake Consensus**: each agent stakes real-world assets (RWA) like timber contracts into a decentralized trellis of bonded nodes. Every epoch, agents validate others’ timber provenance claims. False claims trigger automatic slashing—25% of stake is burned, 75% redistributed to honest validators (ocean of trust). Only agents with ≥1000 units staked can propose blocks. Sybils cannot replicate timber ownership digitally; physical asset anchoring forces real skin in the game.
